oneLiner: A dashboard that helps PMs re-orient when switching between projects, showing the last decision made, blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: PMs lose critical context when juggling multiple projects, wasting time on re-onboarding themselves to each project's status, decisions, and dependencies.
coreFlow: User logs in and sees dashboard with all active projects
User selects a project to view its context snapshot
User reviews last decision, current blockers, and pending dependencies
User navigates back to dashboard or drills into deeper project details

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show all active projects with quick-glance status indicators and last updated timestamps

screens.name: Project Context View
screens.purpose: Display the last major decision, active blockers, and list of people/teams waiting on this PM

screens.name: Blocker Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific blocker with owner, timeline, and resolution path

screens.name: Dependency Map
screens.purpose: Visualize who is waiting on what decisions or deliverables from this project

outOfScope: Integration with every project management tool (initial launch supports 2-3 platforms)
